summary: The InactiveUsers module is designed to manage and process inactive user accounts within the HSPnet system. It provides functionalities to view and inactivate old user accounts through web-based interactions.
purpose: To manage inactive user accounts by providing functionality to view all inactive accounts and inactivate old accounts.

workflows.name: Inactivate Old User Accounts
steps: User clicks 'Inactivate All Old User Accounts' button.
Templates are checked for email components.
SQL execution for inactivation with session ID.
Output results are processed and displayed.

workflows.name: View All Inactive User Accounts
steps: User clicks 'View All Inactivated Users Accounts' button.
RunQuery is executed without session ID.
SQL execution for viewing inactive accounts.
Output results are processed and displayed.

business_rules: RunQuery handles both inactivation and view operations.
Email templates are used for notifications during inactivation.
conditions: If SQL execution returns data, display results and rows count.
If SQL execution returns no data, display appropriate message.
system_behavior: The system inactivates user accounts based on session ID execution.
System visibility toggles based on operation results.
exceptions: No data found during inactivation or view operations triggers message display.
